fact: On 3 March 2023 the INStaD Director General reminded that under article 65 of law no. 2022-07 of 27 June 2022 surveys covering at least a commune need a statistical visa, with results of unvisaed operations void (art. 70) and penalties under art. 71.
title: VISA STATISTIQUE : COMMUNIQUE
publisher: Institut National de la Statistique et de la Démographie (INStaD)
